replace_quantization_scales: replace quantization scales in a transformer model for a given model type like starcoder2 or falcon
replace_with_awq_linear: replace linear layers of a model with AWQ quantized linear layers using a quantization config
lookup_awq_scales_mappings: lookup the AWQ scale mappings dictionary for supported model types like gptj, bloom, or mpt
filter_modules_to_convert: filter which modules to convert or skip during AWQ quantization using the modules_to_not_convert list
select_awq_quant_linear_class: select the appropriate AWQ quantized linear class based on bits, group_size, format, and backend parameters
